## Upstream `v1/messages` Debug Guide

This document is for testing whether an upstream LLM service is compatible with Claude Code / Anthropic Messages traffic generated by `claude-sdk-agent`.

### Background

`claude-sdk-agent` does not invent a custom upstream LLM protocol.

It proxies standard Anthropic-style `POST /v1/messages` requests to the configured upstream base URL.

Current local config:

- upstream base URL: `http://10.2.67.41:18081`
- effective endpoint: `POST http://10.2.67.41:18081/v1/messages`

Code anchors:

- proxy target assembly: `src/provider/proxy.py`
- upstream base URL source: `config/service.json`

### Request headers

The sidecar forwards requests to upstream with headers like:

```http
Content-Type: application/json
anthropic-version: 2023-06-01
x-user-id: 10154402
X-User-Id: 10154402
authorization: Bearer <api_token>
x-api-key: <api_token>
api-key: <api_token>
```

If present on the original request, it may also forward:

```http
accept: text/event-stream
anthropic-beta: ...
uac-user-id: ...
uac-user-token: ...
x-uac-user-id: ...
x-uac-user-token: ...
```

### Test objective

We want to distinguish these two cases:

1. The upstream service supports ordinary Anthropic `messages` chat only
2. The upstream service fully supports Claude Code style tool-loop traffic

If case 1 is true, normal chat may succeed but requests containing `tool_use` / `tool_result` may fail with `400 Bad Request`.

## Test 1: Plain chat

Use this first to verify basic compatibility.

```bash
curl -v http://10.2.67.41:18081/v1/messages \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
  -H 'x-user-id: 10154402' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <api_token>' \
  -d '{
    "model": "MiniMax-M2.7",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "stream": false,
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "你是谁？你能做什么？"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

Expected outcome:

- If this fails, the upstream service is not even compatible with basic `v1/messages` chat
- If this succeeds, continue with Test 2

## Test 2: Tool round-trip

This is closer to the traffic Claude Code generates during tool execution.

```bash
curl -v http://10.2.67.41:18081/v1/messages \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
  -H 'x-user-id: 10154402' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <api_token>' \
  -d '{
    "model": "MiniMax-M2.7",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "stream": false,
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "发个 icenter 消息给王建雄10154402，内容是 hello"
      },
      {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": [
          {
            "type": "tool_use",
            "id": "toolu_demo_1",
            "name": "Bash",
            "input": {
              "command": "echo hello"
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
          {
            "type": "tool_result",
            "tool_use_id": "toolu_demo_1",
            "content": "command exit 0"
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }'
```

Expected outcome:

- If Test 1 succeeds but Test 2 returns `400 Bad Request`, the upstream service is likely not compatible with Claude Code tool-loop message structures
- In that case, the load-balanced upstream pool probably contains nodes that only support plain chat, not Claude Code traffic

## Test 3: Streaming mode

If the upstream service is expected to support streaming, test SSE as well.

```bash
curl -N -v http://10.2.67.41:18081/v1/messages \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
  -H 'x-user-id: 10154402' \
  -H 'authorization: Bearer <api_token>' \
  -d '{
    "model": "MiniMax-M2.7",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "stream": true,
    "messages": [
      {
        "role": "user",
        "content": "你是谁？你能做什么？"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

Expected outcome:

- Response should be `text/event-stream`
- If non-stream works but stream fails, the upstream service may not support Anthropic-style SSE output

## Recommended feedback to return

Please provide:

- full HTTP status code
- response headers
- response body
- whether failure only happens when `tool_use/tool_result` is present
- whether failure only happens on some load-balanced backends

## Quick conclusion matrix

- Plain chat fails:
  - upstream does not support basic Anthropic `v1/messages`
- Plain chat works, tool round-trip fails:
  - upstream likely does not support Claude Code tool-loop messages
- Plain chat works, tool round-trip works, stream fails:
  - upstream likely lacks Anthropic SSE compatibility
- Only some requests fail behind load balancing:
  - backend capability is inconsistent across nodes
